analysis:
All three changed files are live test fixtures or tests under provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/Inference/Live. No production sources, coordinator contract, key handling, attestation or authorization code changed.

GPTOSSCheckpointRestartFixture.swift adds `sdkPrefillGeometry`, which sets EngineV2Factory.prefillChunkKey and stepTokenBudgetKey from CBv2SchedulerConfig defaults (512-token company chunks). `makeBridge` gains an `environment` overrides parameter, merged over the base environment. Overrides sit in a test-only environment dictionary passed to makeProductionBuild. They do not touch process env or any production default. The store is still constructed by the fixture. The cache epoch binding, HMAC fingerprint, ephemeral KEK, tenant-salt checks and the negative-key readStreaming check (lines 229-260) are unchanged.

GPTOSSCheckpointRestartLiveTests.swift passes the SDK geometry in the donor and restored bridges so the solo-to-company cap change is still exercised. The updated comment says production GPT-OSS keeps 2,048-token chunks throughout.

Qwen35CheckpointRetentionFixture.swift (head lines 235-240) adds explicit prefill chunk and step token budget keys alongside the existing stripe override, and updates the doc comment. The KV backend (.paged) and the paged-layout, scope and encryption assertions are unchanged.

T-041 (SSD prefix cache) is the nearest threat. The test-only changes do not alter the lookup-tag derivation, TTL, account scoping or at-rest crypto in the production tier. The fixtures use temporary directories and ephemeral keys, and the roots are removed on close. I found no new attack surface or regression. Remaining caveat: the production default prefill geometry for GPT-OSS and Qwen lives in unchanged code that was not supplied. I did not verify it, and it is outside this diff.
